title: Evapotranspiration Process Boundary, State & Migration Readiness

root_water_uptake.ownership_rule: ET publishes potential transpiration demand only; actual root uptake remains root-uptake owned.

crop_canopy.ownership_rule: Crop biology and continuation state remain crop-owned; ET consumes read-only canopy views.

restricted_reference_et_transpiration.governance_rule: Use as evidence/provider contract only. Re-admit on current lineage in a separate implementation unit; do not blindly merge the historical branch.

key_readiness_findings: Potential ET demand, interception, soil-evaporation reduction, actual surface evaporation and actual root uptake are separate ownership boundaries.
Potential transpiration is not actual root uptake and ET must not duplicate Feddes/root-sink physics.
Potential bare-soil and pond evaporation are atmospheric demands; hydraulic limitation and actual reva/epd belong to the top-boundary/soil-water owner.
SWINTER=1/2 are explicit source-window aggregate methods; SWINTER=3 is a dynamic optional canopy-water storage process with a physical event bound.
Legacy LDWET/SPEV/SAEV are true restart continuation state and must be option-specific transactional state.

Legacy reduceva mutates state before the SoilWater retry loop; the target architecture must recompute rejected/retried trials from committed ET state rather than preserve this control-flow mutation pattern.
Legacy siccaploss is counted as interception loss when canopy capacity falls; this reference mass route is frozen and may not be silently changed in a structural migration.
Daily weather and interception semantics are forcing/event semantics, not a kernel-day timestep requirement.
Meteorological file arrays, filenames, cursors and update flags stay outside the kernel.
All actual water removals and state deltas enter the authoritative mass ledger exactly once at transaction acceptance.

required_reuse: F-WOF18 qualified transpiration semantics as evidence

not_qualified: broader root-water-uptake physics outside F-VQ22 scope
any physics correction to legacy siccaploss semantics
testing_note: No production source changed in F-PM06, so no production build/regression claim is made. The readiness qualification is based on live lineage reconciliation, frozen-source equation/call-order inspection, qualified owner contracts, explicit migration boundaries and a clean two-file diff before this status record. The structural implementation unit must carry its own compilation, regression, replay and mass-balance qualification.
next_action: Start a separate production implementation workunit for the restricted stateless reference-ET demand slice on the current canonical lineage. Do not extend F-PM06 with production source changes.
